% cspell:ignore RUBInter
\usepackage{changepage}
\usepackage{tikz}

\definecolor{RUBblue}{RGB}{0, 53, 96}
\definecolor{RUBlightblue}{RGB}{220, 235, 251}
\foreach \RUBfont in {Regular,Italic,SemiBold,ExtraBold}{
  \IfFileExists{themes/rub/fonts/RUBInter-\RUBfont.ttf}{}{%
    \PackageError{RUB theme}{Missing RUB Inter fonts. Run pixi run rub-fonts}{Download the official fonts before rendering the RUB PDF.}%
  }
}
\newfontfamily\RUBtitlefont{RUBInter}[
  Path=themes/rub/fonts/,
  Extension=.ttf,
  UprightFont=*-Regular,
  BoldFont=*-SemiBold,
  ItalicFont=*-Italic
]
\newfontfamily\RUBheadingfont{RUBInter-ExtraBold.ttf}[Path=themes/rub/fonts/]
\newcommand{\RUBtheme}{}
